cohort: 108 pregnant women with biologically proven syphilitic infection who gave birth in one of four Reunion hospital centers between 2017 and 2022, resulting in 113 fetuses/newborns.
finding: Fetal and neonatal morbidity and mortality associated with syphilis infection is low in Reunion Island due to early screening and treatment, but a vulnerable patient group remains who require specific antenatal care, and psycho-social vulnerability was significantly linked to congenital syphilis.
